name: Prancha lateral com joelhos apoiados
directions: STATIC SIDE FOREARM PLANK with BOTH KNEES BENT TO90DEGREES. Full body at front-side oblique angle. Chest faces viewer, left supporting elbow under shoulder and forearm flat on floor. LEFT LATERAL KNEE supports body on floor at RIGHT, hips LIFTED so shoulder hip knee straight line. BOTH LOWER LEGS bend BACK at a right angle from thighs and point AWAY from viewer, visible shoes behind knees, NOT a straight leg side plank, NOT feet supporting. Top hand on hip. Clearly separate upper thighs (hip to knee) and folded shins (knee to ankle) at90degree angle, like short-lever side plank. ONE staticpose only.
instructions: Deite de lado, joelhos dobrados e antebraço no chão, cotovelo abaixo do ombro.
Eleve o quadril alinhando ombro, quadril e joelhos.
Sustente respirando normalmente e repita do outro lado.
